summary: Final report BW17_0167 for Selverant Therapeutics Inc: hERG automated patch clamp on 40 compounds (Aminoquinazoline). Study summary table on page 1; full compound tables, methods, controls and deviations follow.

title_block.title: ST03 ion-channel counterscreen, third chemistry shipment
title_block.subtitle: Final Report
lines: Study lead: Dr B. Rowcroft, Screening Operations Director

blocks.p: 40 compounds from the Selverant aminoquinazoline series 03 were tested for Selverant Therapeutics Inc in the hERG automated patch clamp. Testing started on 25 May 2017 and results were reported on 14 June 2017. All accepted runs met plate acceptance criteria. 2 of 40 compounds had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds (37 of 40) inhibited hERG with IC50 below 10 µM, so margins will depend on free therapeutic exposure.
To rank the screening set for hERG automated patch clamp liability so that Selverant Therapeutics Inc could choose analogues for progression.

40 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test lot on 25 May 2017 and logged against B-ACC-2017-02854. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client. Stocks were stored at -20 °C and thawed once for testing.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (Kv11.1) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells are held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final). Each concentration is held until the tail-current block reaches a steady state (change below 5% over the last three sweeps), with a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 8 minutes; compounds still drifting at 8 minutes are flagged as slow-onset.
E-4031 is run as a separate 6-point concentration response (1-300 nM) on every run.

list: Plate acceptance: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
E-4031 IC50 within 5-50 nM; runs outside this range are rejected and repeated
IC50 fitted per cell (four-parameter logistic); the compound IC50 is the geometric mean of finite cell IC50s when these are the majority of accepted cells, otherwise reported as >30 µM
Where precipitation is seen at 30 µM, that concentration is excluded and the highest evaluable concentration is reported

blocks.p: All {{PRJ0005:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. 2 of 40 compounds had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds (37 of 40) inhibited hERG with IC50 below 10 µM, so margins will depend on free therapeutic exposure. The median IC50 was {{PRJ0005:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0005:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0005:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0005:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM, of which {{PRJ0005:herg.n_censored}} above the highest evaluable concentration). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0005:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM in the accepted runs.
No deviations from the study plan.

2 of 40 compounds had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds (37 of 40) inhibited hERG with IC50 below 10 µM, so margins will depend on free therapeutic exposure. These are screening data; mechanism statements are outside the scope of this study.
Recommended next steps: prioritise compounds with hERG IC50 at or above 10 µM; for any compound below 10 µM, compare the IC50 with projected free plasma exposure before progression.
Raw data, run sheets and instrument files are retained for 5 years under B-ACC-2017-02854.
